title: Board-approved IT strategy and governance framework
summary: The Board approves an IT strategy and an IT governance framework aligned with business strategy, covering roles, oversight, risk management and value delivery.
typical_evidence: Board-approved IT strategy and governance framework; Board minutes

title: IT Strategy Committee of the Board
summary: An IT Strategy Committee of the Board, with the composition and meeting frequency the Direction requires, oversees IT strategy, risk, resources and the effectiveness of IT governance.
typical_evidence: ITSC terms of reference; membership; minutes for the period

title: IT Steering Committee and Head of IT
summary: Senior management forms an IT Steering Committee and appoints a Head of IT function responsible for IT operations and implementing the strategy.
typical_evidence: ITSC charter; Head of IT appointment; steering committee minutes

title: IT and information security policies
summary: Board-approved IT, information security and cyber security policies are in place, reviewed at least annually and communicated.
typical_evidence: Approved policies with annual review dates

title: CISO and Information Security Committee
summary: A CISO with adequate seniority and independence from IT operations, and an Information Security Committee, oversee information and cyber security.
typical_evidence: CISO appointment; reporting line; ISC minutes

title: IT asset inventory and classification
summary: An inventory of IT assets, information assets and third-party services, classified by criticality, with owners.
typical_evidence: Asset inventory with criticality and owners
category: IT Governance MD 2023: IT infrastructure and services

title: Capacity management
summary: IT capacity is monitored and planned to meet current and future business needs.
typical_evidence: Capacity dashboards; capacity plan
category: IT Governance MD 2023: IT infrastructure and services

title: Change and patch management
summary: Documented change and patch management, including emergency changes, testing, approval, rollback and timely patching.
typical_evidence: Change records for sampled changes; patch reports
category: IT Governance MD 2023: IT infrastructure and services

title: Audit trails
summary: Critical systems generate audit trails for user and system activity, which are protected, retained and reviewed.
typical_evidence: Audit logging configuration; log retention; review records
category: IT Governance MD 2023: IT infrastructure and services

title: Access control and privileged access
summary: Least privilege and role-based access; periodic access reviews; privileged access management; MFA for privileged and remote access.
typical_evidence: Access reviews; PAM configuration; MFA exports
category: IT Governance MD 2023: Information and cyber security

title: Cyber security risk assessment and VAPT
summary: Periodic IT and cyber risk assessments; vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of critical and internet-facing systems, with findings remediated on time.
typical_evidence: Risk assessment; VAPT reports; remediation tracking
category: IT Governance MD 2023: Information and cyber security

title: Security monitoring (SOC)
summary: Continuous security monitoring through a security operations centre (own or outsourced), as applicable to the regulated entity.
typical_evidence: SOC contract or setup; monitoring use cases; alert records
category: IT Governance MD 2023: Information and cyber security

title: Cyber incident response and reporting
summary: An incident response and recovery process, with reporting of cyber incidents to RBI and CERT-In within the prescribed timelines (verify the current RBI window; CERT-In requires 6 hours).
typical_evidence: Incident response plan; reporting procedure; incident reports filed
category: IT Governance MD 2023: Information and cyber security

title: Data security
summary: Data classification and protection, including encryption of sensitive data at rest and in transit, and data leak prevention appropriate to risk.
typical_evidence: Data classification policy; encryption settings; DLP
category: IT Governance MD 2023: Information and cyber security

title: Business continuity and disaster recovery
summary: A Board-approved BCP and DR policy, with RTO and RPO for critical systems and periodic DR drills; results reported to senior management.
typical_evidence: BCP and DR policy; DR drill reports; RTO and RPO

title: Information systems audit
summary: A risk-based IS audit function and plan, overseen by the Audit Committee of the Board, with IS audits at the required frequency and tracked findings.
typical_evidence: IS audit policy and plan; IS audit reports; findings tracker

title: Board-approved IT outsourcing policy
summary: Regulated entities have a Board-approved policy for outsourcing IT services, including materiality assessment, and remain responsible for outsourced activities.
typical_evidence: Outsourcing policy; materiality assessments

title: Due diligence of service providers
summary: Risk-based due diligence before engagement and periodically: capability, financial soundness, security controls and certifications.
typical_evidence: Due diligence records; vendor security assessments

title: Contract terms
summary: Agreements cover service levels; data confidentiality and security; data location; sub-contracting; incident notification; audit and inspection rights for the RE and RBI; business continuity; termination and exit.
typical_evidence: Contract clause review; for vendors: the RE's outsourcing addendum

title: Audit and inspection rights for RE and RBI
summary: Service providers give the regulated entity and RBI (or their auditors) access to records, premises and audit reports.
typical_evidence: Contract audit clause; audit reports shared (SOC 2 or ISO certificate)

title: Incident notification by service provider
summary: Service providers notify the regulated entity of security incidents promptly so it can meet its reporting duties.
typical_evidence: Contract notification clause; incident procedure step to notify RE customers

title: Provider business continuity and exit
summary: Service providers maintain and test BCP and DR; the RE has an exit strategy to move services without disruption.
typical_evidence: Provider BCP test results; exit plan

title: Cloud and shared services controls
summary: Extra controls for cloud use: data residency, isolation, encryption and key management, and audit of cloud providers.
typical_evidence: Cloud security configuration; data location; key management

title: Payment system data stored only in India
summary: All data relating to payment systems operated by system providers (full end-to-end transaction details) is stored only in India.
typical_evidence: Data location evidence (cloud regions; database locations) for payment data

title: Foreign processing brought back to India
summary: Where processing happens abroad, the data is deleted from foreign systems and brought back to India within the timeline RBI specifies (one business day or 24 hours after processing).
typical_evidence: Data flow documentation; deletion job evidence for any foreign leg

title: System audit report on data localisation
summary: A system audit report by a CERT-In empanelled auditor confirms compliance with the storage requirement and is submitted to RBI as required.
typical_evidence: SAR by a CERT-In empanelled auditor; submission record
